description: Returns a collection of playlists matching the supplied query parameters. The response includes playlist metadata and a zip URL for high‑quality MP3 files (limited to ~100 tracks). The 'limit' parameter defaults to 10 and is capped at 200 (even when using 'all'). Using 'fullcount' may impact performance and is unavailable on heavy methods. The 'order' parameter can be suffixed with _asc or _desc to control direction. The 'datebetween' parameter expects a value like 'YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD'. Only the mp32 audio format is currently supported for the audioformat parameter.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. Using 'all' still returns at most 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field(s). Append _asc or _desc to set direction; ascending is default.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' to the header showing the total number of rows without limit/offset. May affect performance.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more playlist IDs to filter by.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Exact playlist name to filter by.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token of the Jamendo user.

parameters.name: user_name
parameters.description: One or more usernames to filter by.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter playlists created between two dates. Format: YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD (both dates required).

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the file URLs. Currently only 'mp32' (mp3 192kbps) is supported.

responseFields.name: user_id
responseFields.description: Identifier of the user who owns the playlist.

responseFields.name: zip
responseFields.description: URL to a zip file containing up to ~100 high‑quality MP3 tracks of the playlist.

notes: The 'zip' archive may contain fewer tracks than the playlist's total (internal server limit ~100).
'limit' is capped at 200 even when the value 'all' is used.
Setting 'fullcount' can degrade performance and is not available on heavy methods.
When using 'order', append '_asc' or '_desc' to each field to control direction; ascending is default.
The 'audioformat' parameter currently only supports the 'mp32' format.
